outcomes.label: rejected
outcomes.note: rejected and 'not accepted' are in the existing lexicons.

outcomes.label: insufficient
outcomes.note: Seen in stored ticket subjects ('... - insufficient documents').

outcomes.label: in need of correction
outcomes.note: 'Correction Required' is the subject of stored outbound messages; incorrect / wrong / mistake are in the lexicons.

outcomes.label: unreadable
outcomes.note: blurry and illegible are in the existing document_issue intent.

outcomes.label: failing
outcomes.note: fail* and 'not working' are in the existing lexicons.

outcomes.label: pending
outcomes.note: pending is in the existing status_request intent; hold counts exist in workflow data.

outcomes.label: completed
outcomes.note: completed / approved / clear are the terminal stage values in the workflow snapshot code.

outcomes.label: resolved
outcomes.note: In the existing positive lexicon. A customer saying this is a claim, never a verified resolution.
